concept.literalSynthesis: A Jester star musket that consumes real Fallen Stars as ammunition, sending a bright star shot into a falling arc before a hit releases a smaller pursuing star.
concept.coreMechanic: Fire one cursor-aimed, ranged star shot every 0.533 seconds. Each shot consumes one Fallen Star through native ammo selection. The main projectile travels at an authored 33.75 blocks/s and curves downward under 8 blocks/s² gravity; its 31 base damage and 5.25 knockback retain the musket's role. Its first actual NPC hit creates one separate 14-damage child star at the struck target. That child starts at 14 blocks/s and slowly homes within 14 blocks, with its own 1.2-second lifetime and collision. This adds a follow-up hit chance without replacing the direct shot or guaranteeing a second hit. Fallen Stars are consumed whether or not a projectile later hits; there is no mana cost or ammo-saving effect. The musket is reusable and does not consume itself.
concept.parentAContribution: The Jester's Star Musket contributes the Jester-musket identity and a ranged launcher base: 31 damage, 5.25 knockback, 32-tick use timing, and an observed fallen-star ammo requirement. The gravity arc and on-hit child are new authored mechanics, not claims about the source projectile's observed behavior.
concept.parentBContribution: The Fallen Star contributes the actual ammunition identity and its native fallen_star category. The new weapon consumes that ammunition for each primary shot; the child star is a separate authored projectile, not the vanilla ammo projectile copied from the ammunition item.
concept.playerExperience: Aim and fire at a steady musket cadence, budgeting one Fallen Star per shot. A direct hit can release one slower homing follow-up, but the follow-up may miss or be blocked. The held musket remains visible while firing.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Aim the visible musket toward the cursor and fire one gravity-arc star shot, consuming one Fallen Star. On a real NPC hit, that shot spawns one separate slowly homing child star.

realization.description: Fire the Jester's Falling Star Musket toward the cursor. Each shot uses one Fallen Star and travels in a downward-curving arc. A direct NPC hit releases one smaller star that slowly homes toward a nearby target. The musket stays visible in the player's hands. The main shot deals 31 base ranged damage; the child deals 14 base ranged damage. The child can miss, and neither projectile is guaranteed to hit.
realization.playerExperience: The musket is reusable, but each firing consumes ammunition. Its 0.533-second base use interval gives a deliberate firing rhythm. The child star can add a follow-up hit after a successful direct hit, with a shorter lifetime and lower damage.
realization.selfEvaluation: The main shot and child have separate movement calls and complete projectile setup. Fallen-star consumption is configured on the weapon, not by marking it as an ammo item. The child is spawned only by the main projectile's actual on_hit event.
